repair_sufficiency.repair_operation_symbol_binding_required: Each repeated-family repair operation declares target_symbols, and every executable diff marker binds to one of those symbols.
repair_sufficiency.repeated_family_causal_mechanism_rule: causal_mechanism is the deterministic OPERATION_KIND[symbol,...] rendering; free prose cannot authorize a repeated repair.
repair_sufficiency.derived_parameter_exception: Only a declared DERIVED_PER_CASE expression with an explicit bound and complete full-domain proof may alter a scalar sink after two attempts; its proof-slice policy must come from locked C0 evidence rather than the plan.
repair_sufficiency.derived_parameter_implementation_rule: Declared targets and actual changed scalar sinks match one-to-one; each implemented normalized RHS exactly equals its artifact/source/bounds-bound declaration.
repair_sufficiency.current_proof_slice_rule: The current candidate's canonicalized whole source file must match the source exercised by the retained proof, excluding only exact metadata lines authorized by locked C0 evidence and found inside the single static contract function.
repair_sufficiency.failure_family_collection_rule: When observable_exhaustive_collection_required and complete_observable_set_collected are true, collection_evidence must be non-empty.
repair_sufficiency.repeated_family_replacement_rule: with must byte-equal IMPLEMENT_SYMBOLS[ followed by exact ordered unique validated target_symbols separated by commas and ]; no trimming, quantities, prose, suffix, alternate order or extra symbols.
repair_sufficiency.explanatory_prose_rule: target, invariant_enforced and causal rationales are non-authoritative explanation. They cannot grant source symbols or parameter effects. Prose scalar detection is defense in depth; typed operations and exact post-build source/diff and derived-parameter proof checks are authoritative.
repair_sufficiency.operation_contract_migration: Repeated-family legacy or missing version rejects; integration-owner-reviewed plans must explicitly migrate to version2 and regenerate exact C0R bindings.
repair_sufficiency.python_parameter_effect_rule: Repeated Python causal sources require fixed canonical integration-owned exact before/after regular-blob review bindings and mandatory external owner promotion verification. Candidate code/prose cannot authorize itself. No universal AST completeness claim. GDScript derived scalar whole-source/full-domain proof remains mandatory.
